item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 14/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The trough of low pressure affecting the coast of Guangdong will depart gradually. It will be brighter and the temperatures will rise progressively over the region in the next couple of days. Another trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the region in the latter part of this week. A southerly airstream will affect the coast of southern China over the weekend to early next week.
